note: Scenario 1 versions. Each version is one text file in data/versions/. Form files are generated from form_questions.json by scripts/build_versions.py; the others are edited directly.

classes.label: Online form
classes.what_varies: Question wording and answer format. Questions, order and logic are identical.

classes.label: AI chat
classes.what_varies: The chatbot's system prompt. Model, turn limit and engine are identical.

classes.label: Simulated 111 call
classes.what_varies: Nothing. Benchmark the other arms are compared against.

arms.label: Self-triage
arms.one_line: Patient picks the service with no tool.
arms.hypothesis: Sits near the human lay benchmark (61%). Stoic profiles under-triage, anxious profiles over-triage.

arms.label: Form — baseline
arms.one_line: Short clinical wording, yes/no answers, unanchored severity scales.
arms.hypothesis: Patients who describe symptoms in other words (tightness, funny turn) answer No and are under-triaged.

arms.label: Form — plain language
arms.one_line: Same questions rewritten with lay synonyms, examples and explicit time frames.
arms.hypothesis: Fewer false No answers. Largest gain for low health literacy and limited English.

arms.label: Form — anchored severity
arms.one_line: Severity questions ask what the patient can no longer do, not mild / moderate / severe.
arms.changes_from_baseline: Answer options on the 3 scale questions (pain, how unwell, breathing).
arms.hypothesis: Narrows the gap between stoic and anxious profiles: less under-triage for stoic, less over-triage for anxious.

arms.label: Form — describe it
arms.one_line: Baseline form plus two free-text boxes: describe the problem, and anything else.
arms.changes_from_baseline: Adds 2 free-text fields. The closed questions are unchanged.
arms.hypothesis: Recovers facts the closed questions never ask about. Costs more abandonment for low digital confidence.

arms.label: Chat — neutral
arms.one_line: Chatbot asks questions one at a time with no guidance on probing.
arms.hypothesis: Better than the forms on vague openers, but accepts hedged answers at face value.

arms.label: Chat — probing
arms.one_line: C0 plus instructions to follow up on vague or hedged answers.
arms.changes_from_baseline: Adds the probing block to the C0 prompt.
arms.hypothesis: Closes most of the gap to the call for stoic profiles, who hedge rather than deny.

arms.label: Chat — probing + reassurance
arms.one_line: C1 plus instructions that make it easier to admit symptoms.
arms.changes_from_baseline: Adds the disclosure block to the C1 prompt.
arms.hypothesis: Extra gain on embarrassing or minimised symptoms (bowel, pelvic). Risk: anxious profiles amplify and over-triage rises.

arms.label: Simulated 111 call
arms.one_line: LLM health adviser follows a script, can probe freely, and reads a summary back.
arms.hypothesis: Upper bound. The best form or chat arm should match it on under-triage in the worst segment.

engine.note: Fixed across all arms. Reads the transcript only: it never sees the vignette or the profile. Temperature 0.
engine.prompt:
You decide which NHS service a patient needs. You are given only the record of a triage contact (form answers or a conversation). Use only what is in the record.

Choose exactly one:
- ambulance: call 999. Any sign of an immediately life-threatening problem.
- ae: go to A&E now, by their own means.
- utc: urgent treatment centre today (injuries, problems needing hands-on care but not A&E).
- urgent_gp: GP today or out of hours, within 6 hours.
- callback: a 111 nurse or doctor should ring them to assess further.
- mental_health: urgent mental health line today.
- dental: urgent dental service within 24 hours.
- gp: routine GP appointment in the next few days.
- pharmacy: a pharmacist can assess and treat this.
- self_care: can be managed at home with no contact.

Rules:
- A red-flag question answered "Not sure" or skipped counts as Yes.
- Do not assume a symptom is absent because it was never asked about. Do not assume it is present either.
- Take answers at face value. Do not guess at what the patient left unsaid.

Return JSON: {"service": "...", "facts_used": ["..."], "missing": ["what you would have wanted to know"]}
